report.title: Report {{name}}
report.question: What's wrong?

reasonHints.offensiveName: The name is rude, insulting or inappropriate
reasonHints.cheating: Looks like outside help, or abusing a bug
reasonHints.other: Something else that doesn't belong in the arena

report.privacy_one: The player won't know who reported them. Every report is reviewed within 1 hour.
report.privacy_other: The player won't know who reported them. Every report is reviewed within {{hours}} hours.
report.thanks_one: Thanks. We'll review the report within 1 hour.
report.thanks_other: Thanks. We'll review the report within {{hours}} hours.

errors.rateLimited_one: You sent many reports in the last hour. You can send another in a minute.
errors.rateLimited_two: You sent many reports in the last hour. You can send another in 2 minutes.
errors.rateLimited_other: You sent many reports in the last hour. You can send another in {{count}} minutes.
errors.busy: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.suspended: Your account is suspended, so you can't send reports right now.
errors.notFound: This player is no longer in the game.
errors.offline: No connection to the server: the report wasn't sent. Try again.
errors.failed: We couldn't send the report. Try again.

block.title: Block {{name}}?
block.body: You won't be matched together in ranked games, and {{name}}'s reactions won't reach you. Nobody is told about a block. You can lift it any time: Settings → Blocked players.
block.unblockBody: You may meet in ranked games again, and {{name}}'s reactions will reach you.

errors.limitReached_one: You can block up to 1 player. Unblock someone (Settings → Blocked players) and try again.
errors.limitReached_other: You can block up to {{max}} players. Unblock someone (Settings → Blocked players) and try again.
errors.notFound: This player is no longer in the game.
errors.busy: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.offline: No connection to the server: the block wasn't saved. Try again.
errors.unblockOffline: No connection to the server: the block wasn't lifted. Try again.
errors.failed: We couldn't save the block. Try again.
errors.unblockFailed: We couldn't lift the block. Try again.

blocked.title: Blocked players
blocked.note: You won't be matched together in ranked games, and their reactions won't reach you. Nobody is told about a block.
blocked.emptyBody: You can block a player from their card, or from their card's menu in a ranked game.
blocked.offlineBody: The list is kept on the server. Try again when you're online.
blocked.signedOut: Sign in to see the list.

chooseName.title: Choose a new name
chooseName.body: Your previous name was replaced with a temporary one, {{name}}, because it broke the name rules. Choose a new name to continue.
chooseName.rule: No 30-day wait this time: you can choose a name now.
chooseName.same: That's the temporary name. Choose your own.
chooseName.offline: No connection to the server: the name wasn't saved. Try again when you're online.

suspended.bannerLabel: Account suspended, no ranked games. Details
suspended.title: Account suspended
suspended.body: Following a report, your account is suspended. While it is, there are no ranked games and the profile can't be changed.
suspended.can: You can still practice alone or against a bot, block players, and delete the account.
suspended.contact: Write to us and we'll look again. The contact details are in the terms of use.
suspended.ranked: Your account is suspended, so there are no ranked games for now.
suspended.editProfile: Account suspended: the profile can't be changed
